tasks.label: Build Imp Lab (Windows)
tasks.detail: Cross-compile portable imp-lab.exe via editor-windows (cargo-xwin + Bun) into AURA_EDITOR_WIN_OUT (/out). Needs WebView2 on Windows. Requires Dev Container rebuild for docker-outside-of-docker.

tasks.label: Clean editor target if large
tasks.detail: If .mnt/aura-editor/target exceeds AURA_EDITOR_TARGET_MAX_GIB (default 8 GiB), run cargo clean. Oversized debug target/ is a defect.
